blocks.title: Thermoregulation
blocks.text: Thermoregulation ek homeostasis hai jis mein jandar mahol ke darja-hararat (temperature) ki tabdeeliyon ke bawajood apne jism ka darja-hararat qaim rakhte hain.

Zyada darja-hararat enzymes ko denature karta aur metabolism ko nuqsan pohnchata hai. Pode garmi se nipatne ke liye bukharat se thandak (evaporative cooling) istemal karte hain, magar garam, khushk mausam pani ki kami paida karta hai jo stomata band kar deti hai, to aise halaat mein pode takleef uthate hain. Zyada tar pode garmi ke dabao (heat stress) mein zinda rehne ke liye dhal gaye hain, kyunke motadil (temperate) ilaqon ke pode 40 degree Celsius aur us se zyada darja-hararat ka samna karte hain. Un ke cells khaas proteins, heat-shock proteins, bari miqdar mein banate hain jo enzymes aur doosre proteins ko gher kar unhen denature hone se bachane mein madad karte hain.

Kam darja-hararat cell membrane ki rawani (fluidity) badal deta hai, kyunke membrane ke lipids qalmi (crystalline) banawaton mein jakar jate hain, jo solutes ki naqal par asar dalta hai; membrane proteins ki banawat bhi mutasir hoti hai. Pode thand ke dabao ka jawab ghair-sair-shuda (unsaturated) fatty acids ka tanasub barha kar dete hain, jo qalm (crystal) banne se rok kar kam darja-hararat par membrane ki banawat qaim rakhne mein madad karte hain. Is tabdeeli mein waqt lagta hai, isi liye tez thandak hawa ke darja-hararat ke batadreej girne se zyada dabao dalti hai.

Jamane wala (freezing) darja-hararat barf ke qalm banata hai. Agar barf sirf cell wall ke gird bane to poda zyada mutasir nahin hota aur zinda rehta hai, magar protoplasm ke andar bane barf ke qalm jhilliyon aur organelles mein surakh kar ke cells ko maar dete hain. Thande ilaqon ke mukami pode, jaise oak, maple aur gulab, apne cells ke solutes ki tarkeeb badal kar dhal gaye hain, jo cytosol ko barf bane baghair supercool hone deti hai, agarche cell walls mein barf ke qalm ban sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Achanak pala (frost) us pode ko kyun maar deta hai jo wohi darja-hararat aahista pohnchne par zinda reh jata?
blocks.explanation: Thand ke khilaf jhilliyon ki hifazat mein waqt lagta hai: pode ko unsaturated fatty acids ka tanasub barhana hota hai taake lipids qalm na banein, aur apne solutes badalne hote hain taake cytosol supercool ho sake. Batadreej girna is ki ijazat deta hai; achanak thandak nahin, to jhilliyan sakht ho jati hain aur protoplasm ke andar barf ban kar cells ko maar sakti hai.

items: Garmi enzymes denature karti hai; pode bukharat se thande hote aur heat-shock proteins banate hain jo proteins ko denature hone se bachate hain (temperate pode 40 degree aur zyada ka samna karte hain).

Thand membrane lipids ko qalmon mein jakar deti hai; pode unsaturated fatty acids jorte hain, aahista, is liye achanak thandak buri hai. Jamna tab maarta hai jab protoplasm ke andar barf bane; thande ilaqon ke pode (oak, maple, gulab) solutes badalte hain taake cytosol supercool ho.
